# Resomi
Resomi are a small avian-like species that hail from an icy world.
## Diet
- Like most other non-human species, Resomi are capable of digesting raw meat and other uncooked animal proteins.
## Benefits
- As a result of the conditions of their home planet and ammonia-based blood, Resomi are [color=#1e90ff]immune to any cold damage and other effects.[/color] - Due to their small size, they can fit in duffelbags. - Their unarmed attack deals [color=#ec3a3a]Slash[/color] damage.
## Drawbacks
- They find temperatures that most other species find comfortable to be unbearably hot, finding themselves [color=#ffa500]suffering starting at just 30°C.[/color] - Along with their temperature tolerances, they [color=#ffa500]take 30% more heat damage and 15% more brute damage.[/color] - They have weaker bones. - They weigh less, making it harder for them to pull other species. - Resomi have [color=#ffa500]33% less blood[/color], allowing them to suffer from blood loss much sooner.
Resomi do not spawn in naturally during events, typically [color=#449944]only appearing during admemes[/color].
## Resomi Naming Conventions
Resomi typically use a singular word naming convention, with their names typically only containing two or three syllables. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Tevan - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Melise - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Nialum - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Lianese - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] T Rex - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Fossil
## Lore
In recent years, there have been many attempts to resurrect the Resomi species by geneticists of all types of species in order to find out all the unanswered questions left behind and to confirm the theories present behind Avali. Due to lacking genetic material which is also outdated, however, no successful resurrection attempts have had any cultural memory nor had the ability to reproduce. Though many species only find despair when looking at the fate of what must of been a great civilization, the Resomi who have been remade simply see it as a chance to make their own memories with the life gifted to them.
